entries.title: The Medium

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with scalable settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best archive route because it offers the full game natively with PC settings and capture flexibility, while no sourced platform-exclusive story or gameplay content was identified elsewhere.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Medium on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Use PS5, Xbox Series X|S, macOS, Luna, or Switch cloud only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original release; no remake/remaster distinction applies.
